summary: Figures on flat tiles. layout "row": 3 or 4 tinted tiles in one row, each a large number over a short two-line label, with an optional heading above (a proof strip right under the hero). layout "split": heading and one or two paragraphs on the left, a 2x2 grid of tiles on the right with an optional icon, the figure, a caption and an optional round arrow link; the two diagonal tiles are filled in the brand colour. Numbers count up once when seen.
